page_title: CHE 2-0 BRE | Chelsea v Brentford 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Brentford.
90+4' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Robert Sanchez has no trouble gathering it.
90+4' Substitution. Romelle Donovan (Brentford) in, Yegor Yarmolyuk out.

90+4' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. Corner kick. Brentford will have an opportunity.
90+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was probably a bit loose with his words to John Brooks, who decides to show him a yellow.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
85' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) replacing Reece James.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) is coming onto the pitch as Enzo Fernandez cannot continue after picking up an injury.

84' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Free kick. Chelsea will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
83' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) attempts to discuss the decision with John Brooks, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
82' Here is a change. Rico Henry is going off and Keith Andrews gives the last tactical orders to Aaron Hickey (Brentford).
82' Here comes a substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Kevin Schade.
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Chelsea.
78' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Keith Andrews has decided to substitute Mikkel Damsgaard and he is replaced by Dango Ouattara (Brentford).
76' 2 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Caoimhin Kelleher into right side of the goal.
76' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to take the penalty!
75' Caoimhin Kelleher (Brentford) brings his opponent down. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Chelsea.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Liam Delap (Chelsea) replaces Joao Pedro.
73' Igor Thiago (Brentford) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
72' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
70' Reece James (Chelsea) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
70' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) sees a yellow card from John Brooks after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
64' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
61' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

61' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Wesley Fofana comes onto the pitch to replace him.
57' Alejandro Garnacho goes off the pitch and Andrey Santos (Chelsea) comes on.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
51' Rough tackle by Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

49' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+4' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) has too much to say to the referee and receives a caution.
45+1' A cross into the box from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is cleared.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
42' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Reece James (Chelsea) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
41' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
40' CHANCE! Mathias Jensen (Brentford) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Robert Sanchez, who produces an excellent reflex save.

38' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post! The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
36' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but John Brooks ignores the protests.

36' Kevin Schade (Brentford) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
36' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is about to take a corner kick.

34' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
33' A cross from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
31' The referee blows his whistle as Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) was too aggressive in his challenge.
28' Referee John Brooks points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Joao Pedro (Chelsea) goes wild in celebration.
27' Wait! Referee John Brooks has indicated he is going to review the Chelsea goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
26' 1 - 0 Enzo Fernandez feeds the ball through to Joao Pedro (Chelsea), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly drills it into the roof of the net! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
24' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) passes the ball onto Reece James, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
21' Kevin Schade (Brentford) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
19' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and John Brooks blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Brentford, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
18' Reece James (Chelsea) works the corner short.
17' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Chelsea win a corner.

14' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
14' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
13' A raking crossfield pass from Rico Henry (Brentford) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sprays a pass out to Joao Pedro, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
10' Chelsea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
7' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
6' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
6' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Michael Kayode (Brentford) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
1' Kevin Schade (Brentford) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
1' The first half has started.
Brentford will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be John Brooks.
